leads.title: Buat Aplikasi Komunitas Android
leads.summary: Saya ingin membangun sebuah aplikasi komunitas atau sosial khusus untuk perangkat Android. Aplikasi ini harus memungkinkan pengguna membuat profil, bergabung atau membuat grup, berbagi postingan (teks, foto, dan video si

why.ar: المشروع يطلب تطبيق أندرويد أصلي (Native Kotlin) مع ميزات مجتمعية مثل ملفات تعريف المستخدمين والمجموعات والمشاركات والإشعارات الفورية، وكلها يمكن تنفيذها باستخدام Firebase. Moe متخصص في تطبيقات أندرويد الأصلية وFirebase ولديه خبرة في الميزات المجتمعية. كما أنه يستخدم التطوير بمساعدة الذكاء الاصطناعي لزيادة الكفاءة.
why.en: The project requests a native Kotlin Android community app with features like user profiles, groups, posts, and real-time notifications, all of which can be implemented using Firebase. Moe specializes in native Android apps and Firebase, and has experience with community features. He also uses AI-assisted development for efficiency.

watch.ar: الميزانية (250-750 دولارًا أمريكيًا) قد تكون منخفضة قليلاً بالنسبة لنطاق تطبيق مجتمعي كامل مع تحميل الوسائط والإشعارات في الوقت الفعلي، لذا يجب إدارة توقعات العميل بشأن نطاق MVP. كما أن ذكر React Native كخيار قد يكون علامة حمراء، لكن Kotlin هو الخيار المفضل لموي.
watch.en: The budget ($250-750 USD) might be a bit low for the full scope of a community app with media uploads and real-time notifications, so client expectations for an MVP need to be managed. The mention of React Native as an option is a slight red flag, but Kotlin is also explicitly offered and is Moe's preference.

leads.proposal:
I understand you're looking to develop a dedicated Android community application, enabling users to create profiles, join groups, share content, and receive real-time notifications. My focus is on building robust native Kotlin Android apps with efficient Firebase backends for features like user authentication, database management, and push notifications. I leverage AI-assisted development to streamline the coding process, ensuring a high-quality product. For instance, my app Peace & Conflict 24 includes a news dashboard and live chat, demonstrating experience with community-focused features. I can deliver your app with a simple, modern UI/UX and a basic admin dashboard as requested.

You can try my live apps here:
https://play.google.com/store/apps/developer?id=MonteCarlo+News24

Could you share more details about the specific types of media users will be able to upload, and if there are any particular content moderation rules you envision for the admin dashboard?

leads.title: MySQL Mobile Number Export
leads.summary: I need a specialist who can connect to our Android app’s MySQL backend and extract only the authorised users’ mobile numbers. Once pulled, the data has to be organised cleanly into both a CSV file and an Excel spreadshee

why.ar: المشروع يتضمن التعامل مع قاعدة بيانات مرتبطة بتطبيق أندرويد، وهو مجال يمكن لـ Moe التعامل معه بفضل خبرته في Firebase وتطوير التطبيقات المدعوم بالذكاء الاصطناعي لاستخراج البيانات.
why.en: The project involves interacting with an Android app's backend database, a task Moe can handle given his Firebase experience and AI-assisted development for data extraction.

watch.ar: يجب الانتباه إلى أن المشروع يطلب التعامل مع MySQL بينما خبرة Moe الأساسية في Firebase. كما أن الميزانية منخفضة نسبياً لمهمة حساسة تتعلق بقاعدة البيانات.
watch.en: Note that the project specifically requests MySQL interaction, whereas Moe's primary backend experience is with Firebase. The budget is also relatively low for a critical database task.

leads.proposal:
I understand you need a specialist to securely extract authorized mobile numbers from your Android app's MySQL backend and format them into CSV and Excel files. My expertise lies in building robust Android apps with AI-assisted development, including backend integration for data management. While my primary backend experience is with Firebase, I am adept at database interaction and can leverage AI tools to ensure precise and secure MySQL data extraction, adhering to your strict accuracy and security requirements. For instance, my 'Islam Rising' app manages user worship data across 177 countries, demonstrating my capability in handling sensitive user information and backend operations.

You can try my live apps here:
https://play.google.com/store/apps/developer?id=MonteCarlo+News24

Could you provide more details on the specific MySQL version and the schema of the user table from which the numbers need to be extracted?
